cases.expected_sql: SELECT r.region_name AS region, ROUND(SUM(o.revenue) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(SUM(o.revenue)) OVER (), 0), 4) AS revenue_share FROM demo_business.orders o JOIN demo_business.regions r ON r.region_id = o.region_id GROUP BY r.region_name, r.region_id ORDER BY revenue_share DESC, r.region_id ASC

cases.question: 按月统计收入环比
cases.expected_sql: WITH monthly AS (SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', o.order_date) AS month, SUM(o.revenue) AS revenue FROM demo_business.orders o GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('month', o.order_date)) SELECT month, revenue, ROUND((revenue - LAG(revenue, 1) OVER (ORDER BY month)) * 100.0 / NULLIF(LAG(revenue, 1) OVER (ORDER BY month), 0), 4) AS revenue_mom FROM monthly ORDER BY month ASC

cases.question: 按月统计收入同比
